jobs.description:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Do you speak multiple languages, have a knack for logistics, and always keep track of everything? Join FELFEL’s dispatcher team as an Working Student Operations & Logistics (50-60%, hourly contract) in either Zurich Wiedikon or Lausanne Flon and help us elevate our operational excellence!

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure high-quality service and a smooth operational experience by consistently monitoring our service standards to keep customer satisfaction as a top priority.

• Communicate effectively with our third-party logistics partners and multilingual drivers across various channels, acting quickly while maintaining a clear overview.

• Act as a key point of contact for operational supply chain processes, driving efficient organization, oversight, and proactive issue resolution.

• Coordinate closely with our customer service and hardware teams to resolve any challenges quickly and efficiently.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Practical experience in an operational, logistics, or coordination role is a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills to engage effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders as a dedicated team player.

• Exceptional eye for detail combined with a natural talent for multitasking and seamless organization.

• Solution-oriented mindset and high motivation, maintaining focus and drive even when navigating complex challenges.

• Fluency in English is required. For the Zurich office, fluency in German is essential, while for the Lausanne office, fluency in French is necessary (speaking all three is a fantastic bonus!).

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Hourly rate of CHF 25.00 with regular working shifts.

• Enjoy fresh, high-quality meals just steps away from your workspace, every day.

• Fuel your day with barista-style coffee and premium tea, thanks to our Gavetti machine.

• Work in a collaborative environment that values initiative and gives you the space to contribute your ideas.

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either English or French.

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
 FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;). FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York. www.felfel.ch

FELFEL VALUES

jobs.title: Senior Techniker Kälte- & Elektrotechnik
jobs.description:
## IN KÜRZE

Du bringst analytische Schärfe, fundiertes Elektro-Know-how und eine echte Hands-on-Mentalität mit? Als Senior Techniker Kälte- & Elektrotechnik (100%) in Zürich mit schweizweiten Einsätzen bist du die entscheidende technische Instanz für unsere Flotte an vernetzten Kühlschränken und Kaffeemaschinen. Du bringst deine technische Handschrift ein, etablierst saubere Root-Cause-Analysen und entwickelst unser 12-köpfiges Techniker:innen-Team fachlich auf das nächste Level.

## DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Führe als Eskalationsstufe komplexe Fehlerdiagnosen auf Komponentenebene an unseren Kühlgeräten und Kaffeemaschinen durch.

• Entscheide durch fundierte Triage und tiefes Verständnis für Kältekreisläufe präzise zwischen Gerätestörung, Konfigurationsfehler oder Telemetrie-Problem.

• Übernehme die technische Dokumentation (Risikobeurteilung, Schaltpläne, Konformität nach NEV/EMV) für unsere eigene CAREL-Integration und das POS-System.

• Prüfe neue sowie reparierte Einheiten laufend auf elektrische Sicherheit und gewährleiste höchste Compliance in der gesamten Flotte.

• Erstelle strukturierte SOPs und etabliere einen nachhaltigen Root-Cause- sowie Postmortem-Prozess zur gezielten Senkung der Recall-Kosten.

• Coache unser 12-köpfiges Techniker:innen-Team und schliesse Kompetenzlücken durch gezieltes Mentoring und eine dynamische Skills-Matrix.

• Organisiere Herstellerschulungen (z. B. Eversys) und sorge für einen sichtbaren, kontinuierlichen Weiterbildungsfortschritt.

## WAS DU MITBRINGST

• Anerkannte Elektronik- oder Automatikausbildung (z. B. Elektroniker:in EFZ oder Automatiker:in EFZ) kombiniert mit fundierten Kenntnissen in der Kältetechnik-Diagnose (Drücke, Verdichterverhalten, typische Störungsbilder).

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Fehlerdiagnose elektromechanischer und elektronischer Systeme auf Komponentenebene.

• Nachweisbare Praxis im Verfassen von SOPs und in strukturierter Root-Cause-Analyse.

• Gutes Verständnis der elektrischen Produktsicherheit (NEV/Niederspannungsrichtlinie, EMV-Grundlagen) oder die hohe Bereitschaft, dir diese Kenntnisse mit Unterstützung unseres externen Sicherheitsberaters anzueignen.

• Selbständige, verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit mit ausgezeichneter Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf allen Teamebenen

• Grosse Leidenschaft sowohl für die praktische, hands-on Arbeit an der Werkbank als auch für das präzise Verfassen von technischen Standards.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

• Pflicht: Gültiger Schweizer Führerausweis (Kategorie B).

• Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder am Arbeitsplatz noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.

• Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung oder Schweizer Pass.

## WAS WIR BIETEN

• Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...

• Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine

• 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, und die Möglichkeit, eine extra Woche zu erwerben

• Wir denken an deine Zukunft und bieten eine überobligatorische Pensionskassenlösung

• Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten

• Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV

• Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

• Bleib in Bewegung und gesund mit unseren wöchentlichen Sportkursen

Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

## IN BREAKDOWN You bring analytical sharpness, well-founded electric know-how and a real hands-on mentality? As a Senior Maintenance & Reliability Engineer (100%) in Zurich with operations throughout Switzerland, you are the decisive technical authority for our fleet of connected refrigerators and coffee machines. You bring in your technical handwriting, establish clean root-cause analyses and develop our 12-member team of technicians to the next level. ## Your responsibilities
• As an escalation stage, perform complex fault diagnosis at the component level on our refrigerators and coffee machines.
• Through in-depth triage and deep understanding of refrigeration circuits, decide precisely between device malfunction, configuration error or telemetry problem.
• Take over the technical documentation (risk assessment, schematics, NEV/EMV compliance) for our own CAREL integration and the POS system.
• Continuously test new and repaired units for electrical safety and ensure the highest level of compliance throughout the fleet.
• Create structured SOPs and establish a sustainable root cause and postmortem process for targeted reduction of recall costs.
• Coach our 12-member technician team and close skills gaps through targeted mentoring and a dynamic skills matrix.
• Organize manufacturer training courses (e.g. Eversys) and ensure visible, continuous training progress. ## What you bring
• Recognised electronics or automatic training (e.g. electronics technician: in EFZ or automatic technician: in EFZ) combined with in-depth knowledge in refrigeration diagnostics (pressures, compressor behaviour, typical fault patterns).
• Several years of professional experience in fault diagnosis of electromechanical and electronic systems at component level.
• Demonstrate practice in SOP writing and structured root cause analysis.
• Good understanding of electrical product safety (NEV/Low Voltage Directive, EMC basics) or the high willingness to acquire this knowledge with the support of our external safety consultant.
• Independent, responsible person with excellent communication skills at all team levels
• Great passion both for practical, hands-on work at the workbench and for the precise writing of technical standards.
• Fluent knowledge of German and very good English.
• Mandatory: Valid Swiss driving licence (category B).
• Non-smokers: in – we don’t want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer appointments. After all, FELFEL is all about good food.
• Valid work permit or Swiss passport. ## What we offer
• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps from your desk - we fulfill all your culinary desires...
• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
• 5 weeks vacation per year, and the possibility to purchase an extra week

 Strategic Transformation (40%)

• Drive the migration from overlapping platforms (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Dropbox) into one unified, modern workplace ecosystem to support hybrid work and international expansion.

• Analyze, redefine, and execute scalable IT processes to elevate internal service levels without increasing headcount.

• Rationalize and simplify our SaaS landscape and optimize software licenses to reduce IT costs by 30–50%.

• Build, scale, and govern automation workflows across IT and business processes while supporting our motivated citizen developers.
 Operational Excellence (40%)

• Manage end-user computing, device lifecycles, and workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, and meeting rooms.

• Implement and improve Identity & Access Management (IAM), including SSO, MFA, and automated user provisioning and deprovisioning.

• Elevate our ITIL-based service management framework to ensure rapid internal support, clear SLAs, and high user satisfaction.

• Standardize processes, maintain data hygiene, and automate workflows across core business systems like ERP, HR, and finance tools.

• Consolidate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and manage software licenses while ensuring data protection and audit readiness.

• Deploy self-service IT solutions and document core processes to maximize team productivity and eliminate single points of failure.
 Business Partnership (10%)

• Partner with department heads to proactively identify and address business technology needs.

• Lead organizational change initiatives to ensure the smooth adoption of new tools and processes across the company.

• Collaborate closely with the engineering and platform teams on authentication, integrations, and shared services.

• Evaluate and pilot innovative digital tools that drive operational efficiency.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 5–7 years of experience in IT or technology operations, with a proven track record of driving platform migrations and SaaS consolidations.

• Background working in fast-growing scale-ups or SMEs (100–500 employees), ideally within retail, logistics, or food service.

• Deep technical expertise in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration, migration, and optimization.

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management solutions (Azure AD, Google Cloud Identity, Okta) and MDM platforms (Kandji, JAMF, Rippling, Intune).

• Proficiency in business process automation tools such as n8n, PowerAutomate, or Zapier.

• Strong understanding of data protection, access controls, and compliance requirements for core business applications.

• High degree of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to make independent day-to-day decisions and balance operational needs with long-term strategic goals.

• Creative problem-solving skills and a proven ability to act as a change agent with limited resources.

• Collaborative mindset with a passion for supporting and consulting the wider organization within a lean team structure.

• Excellent professional communication skills in English and German; French is a strong plus.

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you ready to build the backbone of our smart workplace technology? As our new IoT Platform Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will own the transition of our hardware fleet into a highly reliable, streamlined system. FELFEL puts smart fridges and coffee machines in offices across Switzerland and the US, and every line of code you write will run in a real workplace, serving real people every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the device runtime on our fridges and coffee machine controllers (Gavettis) end to end, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.

• Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single platform, making the architectural choices and defending them.

• Reduce the number of programming languages running on the edge, bringing our cloud and device environments closer together.

• Partner with the Head of Engineering to spec the next generation of fridge and Gavetti hardware, pick vendors, and define the software contracts.

• Manage and evolve vendor relationships and integrations for our vendors and badge reader suppliers.

• Act as the ultimate reality check on the engineering team for what is actually running and succeeding in the field.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 5+ years of experience building production systems, with a proven track record of shipping and operating a real fleet of devices in production (handling real users, outages, and OTA updates).

• Strong working knowledge of edge platform concerns, including networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links), Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.

• Comfort and proficiency across at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, with a willingness to standardize.

• Deep understanding of hardware as an interface, with the ability to navigate Modbus, USB, serial connections, sensor datasheets, and vendor SDKs.

• Experience with Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized workloads is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with commercial appliance ecosystems (like coffee machines or vending) and enough electronics literacy to read a datasheet and ask the right questions.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset—you would rather standardize than invent, and you choose the boring, reliable tool over the purely interesting one.

• Fluency in English, German is nice to have

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
 Are you ready to own the edge runtime for thousands of smart fridges and coffee machines across Switzerland and the US? As our new Edge Platform Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will join a close-knit 8-person engineering team to rebuild and manage the systems that power our hardware. In this hybrid role, you will take full ownership of our edge domain from day one, ensuring that our unglamorous but highly reliable hardware works seamlessly for real people getting their lunch every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.

• Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.

• Streamline the technology stack by reducing the number of languages running on the edge, bringing the device world closer to our cloud environment.

• Collaborate closely with and report directly to the Head of Engineering to specify the next generation of hardware, select vendors, and define software contracts.

• Inherit and manage crucial vendor relationships and integrations, including those for our vendors and various badge reader suppliers.

• Ensure the team maintains a grounded, honest understanding of what is actually running and performing in the field.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.

• Proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, coupled with a willingness to consolidate and standardize our tech stack.

• Working knowledge of edge platform networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links, office networks), running Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.

• Strong ability to treat hardware as an interface, including practical experience with Modbus, USB, serial connections, reading sensor datasheets, and working with vendor SDKs.

• Familiarity with tools like Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or experience in commercial appliance ecosystems is a strong plus.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset with a track record of putting the problem before the programming language, preferring standard, reliable tools over inventing custom solutions.

• Fluency in English, German is nice to have

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

descriptionByLocale.en:
NICE TO MEET YOU!

IN SHORT
Are you a proactive relationship builder who thrives in a dynamic environment? As our Business Development Manager (80 - 100%) in Zurich, you will be at the heart of our customer journey. You will take full ownership of a diverse portfolio, driving client satisfaction, growth, and retention.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and manage a large portfolio of clients from post trial engagement to renewal.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.

• Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross-sell or upsell opportunities.

• Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.

• Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.

• Contract negotiations, account reviews, and renewal or termination processes.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Provide valuable feedback to internal teams based on client insights to continuously improve our offerings and processes.

WHAT TO EXPECT

YOUR PROFILE

• 2+ years of professional experience in client success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.

• Confident use of CRM tools is necessary

• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a sense of hospitality

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to connect effectively with various stakeholders.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while building meaningful, value-driven relationships.

• Fluency in German and English

• Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

• Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY

• Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

• Churn Rate

• Portfolio Growth (Cross-sell/Upsell)

• Client Health Score

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)

OUR BENEFITS

• Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

• Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine

• 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

• Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day

• We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

• New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.

• We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard

• Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

• Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit your CV & complete documents (references, diplomas) in German or English!

APPLY NOW

ABOUT US
FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).
FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

• Condividere preziosi feedback basati sulle informazioni dei clienti con i team interni per migliorare continuamente le nostre offerte e processi. ## Cosa porti
• 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nel successo del cliente, nella gestione del conto o in una posizione simile con il contatto del cliente.
• Dimostrabile successo nella gestione efficiente e nell'espansione di un ampio e diversificato portafoglio clienti.
• L'uso sicuro degli strumenti CRM è un prerequisito.
• Mindset proattivo e orientato alla soluzione con un senso di ospitalità.
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione per interagire efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.
• La capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce durante la costruzione di relazioni significative e di valore.
• Conoscenza fluida del tedesco e dell'inglese.
• Non fumatori – non vogliamo che sentiate odore di sigarette, né al lavoro né alle riunioni dei clienti. Dopo tutto, FELFEL è tutto circa il buon cibo.
• Permesso di lavoro valido o passaporto svizzero. ## Cosa offriamo
• Un sacco di cibo delizioso, a pochi passi dalla vostra scrivania - soddisfiamo tutti i vostri desideri culinari...
• Migliore caffè barista e tè per tutta la squadra grazie alla nostra innovativa macchina da caffè Gavetti
• 5 settimane di vacanza all'anno, e la possibilità di acquistare una settimana extra
• Ogni anno concediamo due settimane intere "lavoro da qualsiasi luogo" e quindi forniamo varietà nel lavoro quotidiano
• Pensiamo al tuo futuro e offriamo una soluzione di fondo pensione supercompulsori
• I genitori appena cotti ricevono 16 o più da noi. 3 settimane di congedo parentale completamente pagato. Sosteniamo anche il ritorno al lavoro fornendo un generoso contributo finanziario all'infanzia fino all'età dell'asilo.
• Finanziamo l'abbonamento a mezza quota e quindi sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti nell'uso dei trasporti pubblici
• Grandi eventi di squadra, come il nostro noto FELFEL Summer Outings
• Rimanere in movimento e sano con i nostri corsi sportivi settimanali Ti sembra il lavoro perfetto? Non vediamo l’ora di saperne di più su di te! EMPLOY NOW con i vostri documenti completi in tedesco o in inglese.
